Sources and update timing

Price, 24h change, market cap, and FDV are read only from each canonical mint’s established Solana/WSOL pair of record. Market cap is recorded only when DexScreener reports marketCap. FDV is stored separately and is never used as a market-cap substitute. DexScreener is an independent index. A snapshot can be delayed, incomplete, or wrong, and does not represent a recommendation.

The existing Registry Market Snapshot workflow archives one public observation per UTC date. This page and its chart image are rebuilt from the latest committed archive when the site builds. The observation timestamp stays visible if publication is delayed.

The audience figures remain dated to their survey. They are updated only through a source review.
